subject: zoology
question_text: Which air pollutants are chiefly responsible for acid rains?

verification.note: Sourced from the Sri Chaitanya Junior Fastrack zoology section (book p.61, VSAQ 161). Zoology holds only ONE source book — the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand covers physics only, and no zoology board paper is in the corpus — so the two-book union check and the back-test are both structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The pollutants
lines: Sulphur dioxide (SO₂) and the oxides of
nitrogen (NO, NO₂) are the air pollutants
They come mainly from the burning of fossil
steps.why: The question names one thing only — which pollutants — so both gases must be written with their formulae, and the source line shows the examiner they were not guessed.
common_mistakes: Naming carbon dioxide. Carbon dioxide causes global warming, not acid rain.
Naming only one of the two gases. Both sulphur dioxide and the nitrogen oxides are asked.
steps.memory_tip: Acid rain has two parents: sulphur dioxide and the nitrogen oxides. S and N, not C.
steps.margin_note: Name the two gases with their formulae, then one line on where they come from.

steps.label: Effects of acid rain

lines.text: SO₂ and nitrogen oxides make acid rain

lines: Acid rain acidifies lakes and streams, and
It speeds up the corrosion of buildings and
steps.why: A two-mark question wants a second point, and the effects are the natural one because they explain why these two gases are singled out from every other pollutant.
common_mistakes: Stopping after the names of the gases. The second mark is for what acid rain does.
Writing that acid rain causes skin cancer. That is the effect of UV after ozone depletion.
steps.memory_tip: Acid attacks three things: water bodies, stone buildings and crops.
steps.margin_note: Three short effects, one line each. Do not write the chemistry of the reaction.

insider_note: Carbon dioxide is the wrong answer here and is the commonest one written — acid rain comes from the sulphur and nitrogen gases.
